lab_based_dose_modifications.trigger_condition: ANC < 1,500/mm3 on Day 1 of each cycle
lab_based_dose_modifications.recovery_criteria: Delay treatment until recovery of ANC to >= 1,500/mm3.

provenance.text_snippet: For absolute neutrophil count (ANC) < 1,500/mm3 or platelet count < 100,000/mm3 on Day 1 of each cycle, treatment is to be delayed until recovery of ANC and platelet count above these values.

lab_based_dose_modifications.trigger_condition: Platelet count < 100,000/mm3 on Day 1 of each cycle
lab_based_dose_modifications.recovery_criteria: Delay treatment until recovery of platelet count to >= 100,000/mm3.

provenance.text_snippet: For absolute neutrophil count (ANC) < 1,500/mm3 or platelet count < 100,000/mm3 on Day 1 of each cycle, treatment is to be delayed until recovery of ANC and platelet count above these values.

lab_based_dose_modifications.recovery_criteria: Reduce carboplatin and paclitaxel doses by one dose level.

provenance.text_snippet: For febrile neutropenia or for grade 4 thrombocytopenia, carboplatin and paclitaxel doses are to be reduced by one dose level.

lab_based_dose_modifications.recovery_criteria: Reduce carboplatin and paclitaxel doses by one dose level.

provenance.text_snippet: For febrile neutropenia or for grade 4 thrombocytopenia, carboplatin and paclitaxel doses are to be reduced by one dose level.

lab_based_dose_modifications.trigger_condition: Bilirubin > 1.5 x ULN with increased ALT above ULN
lab_based_dose_modifications.recovery_criteria: Hold paclitaxel until bilirubin is <= 1.5 x ULN, then reduce dose by one level when treatment is resumed.

provenance.text_snippet: For bilirubin > 1.5 × ULN with increased ALT above ULN that is attributed to protocol therapy, paclitaxel is to be held until bilirubin is ≤ 1.5 × ULN, and the dose is to be reduced by one level when treatment is resumed.

lab_based_dose_modifications.trigger_condition: ALT > 5 x ULN with bilirubin < 1.5 x ULN
lab_based_dose_modifications.recovery_criteria: Reduce paclitaxel dose by one level.

provenance.text_snippet: For ALT > 5 × ULN with bilirubin < 1.5 × ULN that is attributed to protocol therapy, paclitaxel dose is to be reduced by one level.

lab_based_dose_modifications.parameter_name: Any toxicity not attributable to carboplatin/paclitaxel
lab_based_dose_modifications.recovery_criteria: Hold veliparib until toxicity resolves to grade 1 or lower. Upon resuming, reduce veliparib dose one level.

provenance.text_snippet: For any subject who experiences grade 3/4 toxicity which is not attributable to carboplatin/paclitaxel or the underlying disease, the veliparib dose is to be held until the toxicity resolves to grade 1 or lower... Upon resuming veliparib treatment, the dose is to be reduced one dose level.

pregnancy_testing.timing: Serum test at Screening. Urine test prior to dosing at C1D-2 (if serum test >7 days prior) and at each subsequent Cycle Day 1 visit.
pregnancy_testing.action_if_positive: A positive urine pregnancy test will be confirmed with a serum pregnancy test. Administration of study drug must be discontinued immediately.

provenance.section_number: Documentation of Non-Childbearing Status or Pregnancy Test
provenance.text_snippet: For subjects of childbearing potential, a serum pregnancy test will be performed at Screening... A urine pregnancy test should also be performed prior to dosing on C1D-2 if > 7 days since obtaining Screening serum test results. Local urine pregnancy testing should also be performed at each subsequent Cycle Day 1 visit.
